scope: Pinned agent-cycle navigation and native window teardown

repairs.failure: A global application event filter called the page guard after QStackedWidget layout destruction. Offscreen recovered-turn host crashed.
repairs.diagnosis: Native debugger: QStackedLayout::currentIndex -> MainWindow shortcut guard -> AgentCycleController::allowed/eventFilter -> QApplication global event dispatch during child destruction.
repairs.change: MainWindow retires the application-wide AgentCycleController before child-widget teardown.
repairs.regression: Both idle and active-preview teardown failed before fix and passed after; each now destroys three real MainWindows and checks retirement before central widget destruction. Original recovered-turn host suite passes.

repairs.failure: Ctrl+PageDown chose sidebar agent1 instead of most recent agent0.
repairs.change: Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown now step and immediately commit the same MRU snapshot as Ctrl+Tab, preserving numeric sidebar-index shortcuts.
repairs.regression: Actual host verifies MRU forward/backward, immediate commit and both saved drafts; reproducer failed before fix.

limitations: This focused native host gate is not full-app or full-Stagewise parity verification.
